p2.title: Root `tests/` owners have no typecheck gate; the corrected D.93.46 file is gated only by vitest, ESLint and Prettier
p2.evidence: package.json:52 defines `typecheck` as `pnpm --parallel typecheck` (workspace packages only), and the private fixture config `tests/fixtures/phase-3a1b-p3/tsconfig.test.json:22` compiles only `../phase-3a1-a-v3/private-surface.ts` and `seam3-types.ts`. The corrected owner `tests/phase-3a1b-d9346-room-semantics-red.test.ts` (heavy `as never` / `as unknown as` casts, e.g. lines 265, 373, 383) is therefore type-erased at run time and never type-checked by any gate; the two storage-browser owners are covered (whole-package typecheck diagnostics name only inherited Phase-6b fixtures) and `examples/v3-room/src/index.ts` is covered by the v3-room typecheck.
p2.disposition: Pre-existing repository property, not introduced by this correction, and the file passes 15/15 semantically inside the 112/112 retained run. Do not reopen 0b0: record root-`tests/` typecheck ownership in the D.110c-a/b gate list (add a `tests/` tsconfig project or extend the private-fixture config) and close it there. No further confirmation of 0b0 is requested.

p2.title: Successful pending recovery with an unexpected head is classified as availability rather than integrity
p2.evidence: examples/v3-room/src/index.ts:2192-2204 derives the failure code from `Reflect.get(recoveredPending, "kind")`; on the success shape there is no `kind` (packages/node/src/internal/creator-adoption-recover.ts:29-36), so the branch `recoveredPending.ok === true && !sameRoomHead(recoveredHead, selectedPending.next)` falls through to `D110C_FLOOR_RECOVERY_UNAVAILABLE` instead of `D110C_FLOOR_PENDING_INVALID`. Currently unreachable because packages/node/src/creator-adoption.ts:1397-1437 always returns `head: {...expectedNext}` on `ok`.
p2.disposition: Fail-closed either way (no commit, no activation), so no fix in this bounded correction. Assign to D.110c-0b1, where the recovery owner's head vocabulary widens beyond the exact epoch-0→1 tuple: classify an ok-but-unequal recovered head as `D110C_FLOOR_PENDING_INVALID` at that time.

summary: The correction closes all three material findings at the exact causal seams and widens nothing. (1) Pending dominance: examples/v3-room/src/index.ts:1561 refuses any provider `pending` without a successor snapshot declaration with `D110C_FLOOR_RECOVERY_UNAVAILABLE` before the sole `input.openTransport` call (index.ts:2156) and before any activation; with the declaration, index.ts:2176-2206 runs the existing non-activating 0b0a owner `recoverPendingCreatorSuccessorAdoption`, then `commitRoomHeadAdvance` commits and rereads the exact provider tuple (index.ts:966-981) before `reopenCreatorSuccessorAdoption` at 2208, so no cold activation precedes convergence; the migration/redirect and scratch-target opens still skip the floor deliberately (index.ts:1545, 3086) and fail closed at 2169. Cross-genesis epoch-zero state is rejected in capture (index.ts:838 → `D110C_FLOOR_INVALID`). (2) Classification is now correct in both directions: index.ts:956 and 1577 emit `HEAD_AHEAD` only when the authenticated room is ahead of the stable floor and `MISMATCH` when the floor is ahead or otherwise unequal, matching the frozen table at plan lines 92538-92561. Integrity kinds `true-fork`/`chain-invalid`/`stale-head`/`malformed-input` map to `PENDING_INVALID` and the owner's absence/availability kinds (`pending-missing`, `pending-old`, `storage-failed`, `internal-invariant`) remain `RECOVERY_UNAVAILABLE` (index.ts:2199-2203 against creator-adoption.ts:1345-1440). (3) Coverage is now deterministic and product-real: the matrix at phase-6a-creator-successor-product.pw.ts:865-903 drives the actual `createV3RoomSession`/`createV3ChatApplication` composition (pw.ts:560-571) through thin pass-through wrappers, asserts all nine frozen codes, both crash orderings with exact operation sequences (`create,read,begin,read,commit,read` and `create,read,begin,commit,read,commit,read`), `transportOpenCount`/`coldReopenCount` (0/0 for the no-declaration refusal, 1/1 for each recovery, counters reset by `configure` at pw.ts:116), committed `{pending:null, stable:{epoch:1}}`, and a post-recovery `issue` (entry asset 1185). The abrupt-loss fixture now reuses the cached authenticated creator invite (entry asset 973-977; `abandonDirectRoom` deliberately does not evict it) and reads a real verified quarantine declaration from IndexedDB (entry asset 713-745); leaving the interrupted session unreachable is required precisely because graceful close reclaims an unpublished staged generation, and reclamation semantics remain proven elsewhere (retained `phase-6b-cleanup-eligibility-red` and the durable both-ordering 0b0a proof at phase-6b-d110c-0b0a-staged-handoff-red.test.ts:246-290), so nothing is masked. The D.93.46 owner's corrections are fixture-only (canonical invite at lines 290-314, `@ts-drp/node/v3-live` source-seam mock at 114-201, deterministic `vi.waitFor` before close at 783) with its 15 semantic assertions intact, and `roomHeadAuthority: undefined as never` keeps it on the unchanged no-floor path. Evidence checks out: browser-final.json stats are expected 27 / skipped 0 / unexpected 0 / flaky 0 across chromium, firefox and webkit; retained-final.json reports 112/112 passed, 0 failed, 0 pending over 22 suites and the ten files including the D.93.46 owner; SHA256SUMS lists exactly the plan, the four owners, the ledger, the prior review artifacts and both result files, and excludes itself. No production reference to the floor exists outside `examples/v3-room/src/index.ts` and the unchanged `packages/node/src/creator-adoption-activate.ts`, whose `D110C_FLOOR_MISMATCH` is a distinct expected-head equality check and so leaves `tests/phase-6b-d110c-0b0-floor-red.test.ts:47` consistent, and its two source assertions still hold (index.ts:270, 388). Two verification limits, stated plainly: this session had no shell, so the SHA-256 digests in SHA256SUMS could not be recomputed and the 213850db→43290dab diff could not be enumerated; the 'no other owner changed' claim was corroborated only by inspecting the checked-out tree (no stray instrumentation or diagnostic markers in any `packages/*/src` or `examples/*/src` path). Both P2s are minor, assigned, and require no further confirmation.
